# HOW TO FALSIFY A ROW — and you should, because a row nobody re-checks is worth nothing:
#   1. Take the row's `evidence` column. It names a command to run or a file to read.

#   Editing the SENTENCE also invalidates the row: `promise_id` is a hash of (paper, artefact,
#   sentence), so a reworded promise gets a new id and the old row is reported STALE. Re-check, do not

#                   independently of a row adjudicated elsewhere. Still checked; still a row.
#   R  REPAIRED   — the artefact did NOT bear it out; the manuscript was changed in the same pass, and
#                   `note` says what failed and which script repaired it.
#   C  CARDED     — failed, not repairable in-pass; `note` carries a NAMED FALSIFIER.
